messages.subject: Summer social – 27 June, please RSVP
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

The firm summer social is confirmed for Friday 27 June at the Skyline Terrace, Bishopsgate, from 6pm. Partners, fee-earners and support staff all welcome, plus one guest each. Please RSVP by 6 June for catering numbers, and flag any dietary requirements.

Thanks,
Donna
